film.title: Everything Is for the Good
film.logline: A student who has just failed an exam is comforted by their mother's folktale of a king whose painful fall, and a servant thrown into a pit, turned out to save both their lives.
film.audience: Ethiopian students and young adults facing academic failure or other setbacks; secondarily Ethiopian families who pass wisdom to children through stories. Watched on a phone, vertical, often muted.
film.intent: Move the viewer from sadness to curiosity, tension, surprise and a second realisation, and leave them comforted: a setback may have a purpose we cannot see yet. ሁሉም ለበጎ ነው.

voice.style: warm, emotionally expressive and reflective, natural and unhurried, never dramatic or formal; a young woman remembering the evening her mother told her a story

style.style_block: cinematic realistic film still, 35mm film grain, natural light, shallow depth of field, rich earth tones, subject centred in frame
style.negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, cartoon, anime, illustration, blood, gore, weapons, religious symbols, extra fingers, deformed hands

music.caption: cinematic Ethiopian-inspired instrumental score, krar and masinko strings, breathy washint flute, soft kebero hand drum, minor tizita mode; begins sparse and sad, builds slow suspense with low drums, then resolves into a warm hopeful theme
music.chosen_reason: EXPERIMENTS E26: the only candidate that follows the arc. Quiet and dark for the sadness (-23.3 dB, 1.0 kHz centroid), low drums building through the tension, loudest exactly at the surprise (-19.6 dB), then quieter but brighter for the comfort ending (-23.5 dB, 1.9 kHz). Seed 11 stays loud and bass-heavy to the end; seed 47 ends dark and quiet.

the tale opens: the landscape breathes
warm theme returns, fade with the end card

shots.reason: Opens on the feeling the audience knows: coming home after failing. Sadness and empathy before any story.
shots.image_prompt: {student} standing just inside the front door of a modest Addis Ababa apartment at dusk, holding a folded exam paper, eyes wet, head lowered, cool blue light from a window
shots.motion_prompt: she slowly lowers her head, the paper trembles slightly, camera fixed
shots.narration: አልፋለሁ ብዬ ያሰብኩትን ፈተና ወድቄ፣ በጣም አዝኜ ቤት ገባሁ።
shots.subtitle_en: I failed an exam I was sure I would pass, and came home deeply sad.
shots.wan_qc: pass: subtle head and light movement, identity stable over all 49 frames

shots.reason: The mother notices and asks; her care turns sadness toward curiosity, and she begins the story.
shots.image_prompt: {mother} sitting on a sofa in a warm lamp-lit living room, looking up with concern toward someone off frame; on the low table a traditional Ethiopian jebena: a round black clay coffee pot with a long narrow neck and a straw stopper, beside small white cups
shots.motion_prompt: she leans forward gently, camera fixed
shots.narration: እናቴ ፊቴን አይታ፣ «ልጄ፣ ምን ሆነሽ?» አለችኝ። የሆነውን ስነግራት፣ አንድ ታሪክ ነገረችኝ።
shots.subtitle_en: My mother saw my face: "My child, what's wrong?" When I told her what happened, she told me a story.

shots.reason: A five-second, music-only push-in from the living room onto the mother's face (built from s02's own image, so she is the same woman), then a dissolve into the tale: the cinematic bridge between the two worlds.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of {mother} beginning to tell an old story, a soft nostalgic half-smile, eyes looking gently away into the distance as if remembering, warm lamp light on one side of her face, soft dark background
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, her eyes look into the distance

shots.reason: Establishes the folktale world in one wide image: highland road, golden hour, king on horseback, servant on foot.
shots.image_prompt: extreme wide view of a dusty road across green Ethiopian highlands at golden hour: {king} sits mounted in the saddle on the back of a white horse, riding forward, while {servant} walks on foot beside the horse; acacia trees and distant flat-topped mountains
shots.motion_prompt: the horse walks forward slowly, dust drifts, slow pan following them
shots.narration: ድሮ፣ አንድ ንጉሥ ከታማኝ አገልጋዩ ጋር ወደ አንድ ሥነ ሥርዓት ይጓዝ ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: Long ago, a king was travelling to a ceremony with his faithful servant.
shots.wan_qc: reject: the clip was made from the old keyframe (king not riding); no time for a new Wan run before the deadline

shots.reason: The accident, shown after the fact so it stays non-graphic: dust in the air, the king on the ground holding his arm.
shots.image_prompt: {king} sitting on the dusty road after a fall, holding his arm in pain, a cloud of dust in the air, the white horse standing behind him, low angle, golden-hour light
shots.motion_prompt: dust settles slowly, the horse shakes its head, camera fixed
shots.narration: ፈረሱ እግሩን ጉድጓድ ውስጥ ገብቶ ሲወድቅ፣ ንጉሡም ወድቆ እጁንና እግሩን ቆሰለ።
shots.subtitle_en: His horse stepped into a hole and fell. The king was thrown off, hurting his hand and leg.
shots.wan_qc: reject: a glowing flame-like object materialises in the foreground from about frame 20

shots.reason: First time the central line is spoken, by the calm servant: the film's thesis, before anyone understands it.
shots.image_prompt: {servant} kneeling on the road beside the fallen king, calm gentle face, speaking softly, golden-hour backlight
shots.motion_prompt: he speaks softly and nods, camera fixed
shots.narration: አገልጋዩ ግን ተረጋግቶ፣ «ሁሉም ለበጎ ነው» አለ።
shots.subtitle_en: But the servant calmly said, "Everything is for the good."

shots.reason: The injustice: a high angle down into the pit makes the servant small and alone; tension rises.
shots.image_prompt: high angle looking down into a deep earthen pit, {servant} at the bottom looking up toward the light, steep rocky walls, a shaft of evening light
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull-back upward, dust falls into the pit
shots.narration: ንጉሡ ተናዶ፣ አገልጋዩን ጉድጓድ ውስጥ ጥሎት ሄደ።
shots.subtitle_en: Furious, the king threw the servant into a pit and rode on alone.

shots.reason: Peak tension: the king surrounded by an invented, hooded group with torches; danger through shadow, not violence.
shots.image_prompt: {king} surrounded at dusk by figures in hooded earth-coloured cloaks holding torches in a rocky clearing, faces hidden in shadow, no symbols, smoke and firelight
shots.motion_prompt: torch flames flicker, the hooded figures step closer slowly, camera fixed
shots.narration: አካሉ ላይ እንከን የሌለበትን ሰው ለመሥዋዕትነት የሚፈልጉ ሰዎች ንጉሡን ያዙት።
shots.subtitle_en: People seeking someone with no blemish on their body, to offer as a sacrifice, seized the king.
shots.wan_qc: pass: torches flicker, hooded figures and the king stable

shots.reason: The surprise: the wound that hurt him saves him; the realisation lands on his face in torchlight.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of {king}, wearing only a thin simple gold circlet (no large crown), lit by warm torchlight, a quiet expression of dawning realisation, eyes slightly widened and glistening, a cloth bandage wrapped around his hand, dark background
shots.motion_prompt: his eyes widen slowly, torchlight flickers on his face, very slow push-in
shots.narration: ቁስሉን አይተው ግን ለቀቁት። ንጉሡም የአገልጋዩን ቃል አስታወሰ።
shots.subtitle_en: But they saw his wounds and let him go. And the king remembered his servant's words.

shots.reason: Reconciliation, shown in one symbolic close-up of clasped hands over the pit (two-person staging merged the characters in a first attempt); the line is spoken a second time.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of two dark brown-skinned Ethiopian hands clasping over the dark mouth of an earthen pit at dawn: from above, a king's dark brown hand with a gold ring and a deep red sleeve grips and pulls up a servant's dark brown hand in an off-white cotton sleeve, soft golden morning light, dust in the air
shots.motion_prompt: the upper hand slowly pulls the lower hand upward, dust drifts in the light, camera fixed
shots.narration: ንጉሡ ተመልሶ አገልጋዩን አውጥቶ የሆነውን ሁሉ ነገረው። አገልጋዩም «ሁሉም ለበጎ ነው» አለ።
shots.subtitle_en: The king went back, pulled the servant out and told him everything. The servant said, "Everything is for the good."
shots.wan_qc: reject: sparkle noise from about frame 20, full colour melt by frame 48

shots.reason: The second realisation, in one exchange: the pit saved the servant too. A quiet two-shot lets the answer land.
shots.image_prompt: {servant} and {king} sitting side by side on the ground at sunrise, the servant speaking with a gentle smile, the king listening with humility
shots.motion_prompt: the servant smiles softly, the king nods, camera fixed
shots.narration: «አንተን ጉድጓድ ውስጥ መጣሌ እንዴት ለበጎ ሆነ?» ሲለው፣ «ካንተ ጋር ብሄድ ኖሮ፣ እኔን ይሠዉኝ ነበር» አለ።
shots.subtitle_en: "How was throwing you into the pit good?" "If I had gone with you, they would have sacrificed me."

shots.reason: Back to the present in morning light: the result is the same, the student is not. The line a third time, now as their own.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of {student} by a window in soft morning light, a faint calm smile, her mother's hand resting on her shoulder
shots.motion_prompt: a faint smile forms, morning light brightens, very slow push-in
shots.narration: እናቴ ታሪኩን ስትጨርስ፣ ሀዘኔ ጠፋ። ውጤቴ አልተለወጠም፤ አመለካከቴ ግን ተለወጠ። ሁሉም ለበጎ ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: When she finished, my sadness was gone. My result hadn't changed, but my outlook had. Everything is for the good.

lines: ሁሉም ለበጎ ነው · Everything Is for the Good
Images, voice and music were generated by AI models. Based on a folktale my mother told me.
